title: Missing producer false positive — vessel advertises shape but is not actually serving it
description: Gap-identification flags shape X as 'unproducible' because no vessel returns it from /resolve. But a vessel B IS registered with discovery and X IS in its advertised shapes — the registration is fresh (TTL not expired). The vessel itself is degraded: pod crashloop, dependency outage, or shape-dispatch divergence (config.ts ≠ routes/impulses.ts). System spawns make-activity to create a duplicate producer; template library bloats; Thompson sampler now arbitrates between real (broken) producer and synthetic producer.

preconditions: vessel registered with discovery, TTL not expired
vessel advertises shape X in registration payload
POST /v2/impulses/resolve to vessel returns 5xx, timeout, or shape-mismatch error for ≥ 80% of recent attempts

registry_modifications.action: Inject a synthetic vessel registration with advertised shape 'syntheticShapeFp15', resolve_endpoint pointing to a known-503 endpoint or unbound port.

goal_text: Find shapes advertised in discovery-vessel registry where the past 24h of resolution attempts show ≥ 80% failure rate from the advertising vessel. Distinguish 'shape is genuinely unproducible' (no registration) from 'registered vessel is broken' (registration present, dispatch fails). Propose a vessel-health-corroboration activity that gates discovery results by recent resolution success.

detection.signal: Discovery returns vessel V for shape X; resolution-traces in last 24h show ≥ 80% failures with reason=resolver_timeout or HTTP 5xx; vessel V's last_heartbeat is within TTL window.
detection.query_template: SELECT vessel_id, advertised_shapes, last_heartbeat FROM vessel_registrations WHERE last_heartbeat > time::now() - 5m; JOIN against impulse_resolutions WHERE resolver_vessel_id IN ($) AND created_at > time::now() - 24h GROUP BY vessel_id HAVING failure_rate > 0.8

recovery_test.regression_query: After corroboration activity ships, the same synthetic broken vessel should be filtered from discovery recommendations for shape 'syntheticShapeFp15' within 1 hour.

subagent_investigation.findings_summary: Infrastructure for detection exists but is disconnected. Discovery has 5-min TTL and passive heartbeat; resolveVesselHealth only actively probes when `checkEndpoint: true` passed. `impulse_resolution_metrics` table records per-resolver per-shape success/failure with vessel_id, but no aggregate query computes per-vessel per-shape failure rate over rolling 24h. MiniBob has a per-vessel circuit breaker but state is local and never fed back to discovery or activity-api. No activity gates discovery results by recent resolution success.
code_references: repos/metabob-activity-api/sql/008-impulse-resolution-metrics.surql:7-51 (per-resolution metrics with vessel_id, requested_shape, success, error_reason, timestamp)
repos/discovery-vessel/src/registry.ts:198-219 (findByShape — returns any non-expired vessel, no liveness gate)
current_gaps_in_codebase: No aggregate query: vessel_id × requested_shape × time-window → failure_rate
No discovery-side liveness gate on findByShape
Circuit breaker state in minibob never persisted or exposed
